translations.web: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
translations.bsb: But they did not understand this statement. It was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.
translations.kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
translations.asv: But they understood not this saying, and it was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it; and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
